05 / ADA, THIS TIME WITH A COMPILER

Ada.
A woman and a language.

One came before computers. The other reminds you that a variable's type is not an optional suggestion.

begin
end;
A REAL PROGRAMMING LANGUAGETEASCRIPT STAYS IN THE KETTLE
A NAME IN TRIBUTE

She did not write it.
She inspired the name.

The Ada language is named in honour of Ada Lovelace. It emerged from a US Department of Defense competition in the 1970s; Jean Ichbiah led the winning design. The first standard was published in 1983.

Ada Lovelace lived from 1815 to 1852. She therefore neither created the language nor programmed in it. Its name honours her legacy.

History of the language · AdaCore ↗ · Origin of the name · historical report in NASA NTRS, PDF ↗

Strong types.
A soft spot for order.

Three reasons why a compiler
does not have to be your enemy.

01 / TYPES

Tea is not an integer.

A strong type system helps detect misuse of data. Many errors are caught at compile time.

02 / READABILITY

Code is for reading too.

The language favours explicit intent and readability. It takes words like begin and end seriously.

03 / RELIABILITY

More than a pretty demo.

Ada is used in embedded and real-time systems, including aviation and railways. The language alone does not guarantee bug-free software.

Features and applications · AdaCore ↗

Hello, world.
With well-behaved types.

Choose one of three short examples. We will explain what it means and the output it would produce.

Put_Line prints text and ends the line. The Hello procedure is the entry point of this example.

What does Ada 2022 mean?

It is the name of the current approved edition of the standard according to the Ada Rapporteur Group; ISO approval took place in 2023. The next version in development is called Ada 202Y. Status checked on 11 November 2026. Source ↗
